title: Build a Trie (prefix tree) in Go: Insert, Search, StartsWith, Delete
description: Greenfield Go task: implement a Trie data structure for lowercase ASCII strings with Insert, Search, StartsWith, and Delete operations.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement the Trie data structure in internal/trie/trie.go.

Required types:
  type Trie struct { ... }       // prefix tree for lowercase ASCII strings

  func New() *Trie
  func (t *Trie) Insert(word string)
  func (t *Trie) Search(word string) bool    // true only if word was inserted
  func (t *Trie) StartsWith(prefix string) bool  // true if any inserted word starts with prefix
  func (t *Trie) Delete(word string) bool    // removes word; returns false if word not found

Notes:
- Use a 26-child node array for lowercase a-z.
- Delete only clears the isEnd flag; it does NOT prune nodes (so prefixes of deleted words remain reachable).
- Empty string is never considered inserted.

All 5 tests in internal/trie/trie_test.go must pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: Search returns true only for inserted words (not just prefixes)
StartsWith returns true if any word begins with the prefix
Delete returns false for non-existent words
Delete preserves other words sharing the same prefix
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
